mapping.summary: Calculates and settles sales commissions for salespeople and agents
claims: Commissions for employees and external agents
Commission rates by item, item group or combinations of customer, salesperson, dimensions, custom fields
Tiered commissions based on discount or margin
Sales targets with tiered commissions by target achievement
Multiple salespeople per customer, ship-to or document with split rules
Sales teams with roles and manager commissions
Customizable Word reports emailed to salespeople without BC access
Commission payable on invoice posting or on collection
Settlement via settlement documents or purchase invoices
Limited access for salespeople to run reports on own data
Tool to reassign records when a salesperson leaves
Sales statistics excluding external costs like shipping
Separate Spanish version for Cartera support
